Package org.tomlj

Class Toml

java.lang.Object
org.tomlj.Toml
public final class Toml extends Object
Methods for parsing data stored in Tom's Obvious, Minimal Language (TOML).

By default, documents may nest tables and arrays at most 128 levels deep, not counting the root table, and a value, table or array nested deeper than that is reported as a parse error. The limit bounds the stack depth needed to parse and serialize a document; change it with TomlParseOptions.withMaxNestingDepth(int).
